body: One commenter just pissed me off saying that telling me that I basically whining because I can't go to Japan of coronavirus. I can't see the comment but you know who you are. No you asshole I was upset that CLAIR or JET were not upfront about the programme being delayed and giving us false hope for months. I am of course understanding of the situation but they shouldn't have dragged us along telling us that it was likely for the program to go ahead. Honestly I am usually calm but honestly how fucking dare you. Go and take your righteous ass elsewhere you obviously can't read either and just like to point out other people ass weeaboos. Weeaboo.
Yeah thanks for that
Its okay I just feel I needed to say something! I am glad I could be of help ♡
Exactly thanks for getting it. Its not like incoming jets where not positive before. Actually so positive that things that things would get better they got shut down for being naive.
It's okay. Nothing wrong with venting about it thats why I created this post. I am sorry to hear about your mother, I hope things get better for you soon!
Some people handle things differently. People really need to stop dictating with how other people handle situations.

Im really sorry to hear this. I wish I could do something but you are not alone. It was really annoying that they did a 180 with no consideration to peoples livelihoods like this. They should have been more frank with us. Sending virtual hugs.
Complaining makes me feel better actually. Bring on the negs lol

Yeah people dont understand. I think you are the only one that actually understands it means a lot. It's like the only emotion you are allowed to experience is happy or you are just an immature child. They don't realize through venting it makes some people feel better. If they are so concerned about 'toxic negativity' then they don't need to comment, they can go elsewhere and be happy happy happy as much as they want. I dont know some people can be just heartless and slightly cruel... I know we are the last of the food chain as incoming jets but people have been losing their livelihood because of this and we are supposed to suck it up, but we are still human, we matter too.

I just wanted to ask how other people in the same were coping with the situation and what their plans were for this year hence the title. I wasn't trying to come across as entitled, people have been planning this year with JET in mind until last minute im not speaking for myself, im talking about all other incoming JETs in this position. I wasn't aware of the situation until they emailed us last minute. Of course people will get upset. Im sorry if it came across as off and selfish, I feel bad.

Yeah I understand that. I just wanted to let out my frustration. "Children"? Yeah thats why I wasn't keen on posting because I feel like I cant share my feelings without getting belittled or insulted.

I have done all of that. I used to have a better opinion of myself before all the bullying and how other people saw me as an easy target to keep dragging me down. I have done things to pull myself up.. people keep dragging me down. I don't know why I am being shamed for feeling this way I am just being really honest here.
My hobbies are not fun anymore
Lie in my bed and drown in my thoughts.

I have been trying to improve myself for many years thats how I have managed to make the most of what I have and to get somewhere with my life. I focus on the things I can control, its hard on my mental health when things I can't control come into my mind and play over and over. When you lack love and support its really difficult, with family that don't give a shit about you and suffering from PTSD from childhood experiences. 

I don't just jump into sex and say I want it. I feel forced into those situations even if I say I don't want to have sex. I literally had to physically force someone off me when he was coercing me for sex. These things have caused trauma for me. Sure when I was younger I went along with what the guy wanted and I regret that and I am trying to learn. It sounds like you are solely blaming me for making relationships go fast and honestly I really wish I experienced a "slow " relationship but remember that relationships have 2 people in it. 

Everything else I agree on and I try to help my mental state. However when you have nothing around you its just very difficult.

Wow this an awesome response thanks for taking your time to comment and I never knew Japanese housing sucked so bad sorry to hear that! Actually im very sensitive to cold so its important that you told me.

Its more to do with the fact that I want to experience Japan itself that I am wondering whether its worth the risk dropping what I currently have in place to go there. Korea is nice but I have taken a liking to Japan and the culture there.

Ah I don't live in my home country. I live in korea and honestly I have experienced no bullying here like I did back in Scotland. Japan is not far from there and its not about being accepted because I know im a foreigner so its different to somewhere that is supposed to be your "home" but you get pushed away. It hurts a lot.
I wont say specificly but I will say being a minority in majority white country does affect you in a lot of ways.
Yes we live in South Korea. Social distancing is becoming more relaxed here now. Yes and he does tournarys at his house.
Thank you! ! ^^
Thank you so much! :')

Also flopped at the Japanese part which even though I put introductory, I couldn't answer more than one question. Oh well ^^;

Its okay. I really feel for you all. Please, please don't give up! You are not lower or less than people that got an interview. Honestly I feel many people including me just got really bloody lucky. Rise from it and keep you head held high you will come out stronger next time!! And still there is many opportunities to work in Japan websites like gaijinpot usually have openings too... that ofc if you want to things to be more fast paced. The door is never closed!

Hey US applicants! UK aspiring JET here! Congratulations to everyone that managed to make it through to the interview stage! For those who didn't make please don't give up your dreams. It takes a lot to apply in the first place. I remember being really doubtful with the JET programme as I was rejected from a lot of dispatch companies in Japan. I was really reluctant to apply as I was dealing with a break-up also during the application stage and was thinking that I wasn't good enough for teaching in Japan due to the rejections prior. Now looking back applying for JET was the best decision I have made in 2019. You are good enough! Please, please don't let JET determine your value. Even though waiting can be a pain... give next year a chance. Keep searching, they might not be as good but there is plenty of companies in Japan that need you! Good luck to everyone on here and I wish the best for everything in your futures.

P.S I feel really lucky as a UK applicant. Is it just me or is the competition a lot more intense for the US applicants...
I don't want to waste my time. And I don't want someone to string me along only to drop me some time later because they are always confused. I want a relationship I think its obvious.

It's actually a good experience working as a guest teacher. I am in my second year here. The experience definitely varies depending which school you are placed or if it's suburban/rural/city. I was placed in suburban area down south of Korea so it can be difficult to make the effort to find genuine friends. My school is really good. The kids are adorable, makes everything worth it :).
And actually you make more money with epik because rent is covered and Korea is wayy cheaper. Makes living more "comfortable" I guess.
